status: immutable once committed; changes require a new protocol id and re-registration
question: Do Nemotron-proposed, MuJoCo-grounded, bounded edits to the frozen Phase 2A incumbent raise its walking success more often than matched random edits? Secondary: measured evidence vs none; a rule-based heuristic. MuJoCo alone decides.

model.request_order: interleaved M0, N0, M1, N1, ... M14, N14

spend_estimate.note: the token price of this model could not be verified; 5 USD per million tokens is a deliberately high assumed bound

base_controller: frozen Phase 2A incumbent theta0 (15 parameters incl. ramp_s/start_lean at their defaults); R2's winner is not used

seeds.disclosure: Disjoint from every Phase 2A, R1 and R2 seed (including the R2 final seeds 8000-8149, which R3 does not touch) and from the infrastructure-only seeds 9000-9001 (used only by check_env.py compatibility checks; never an experimental role). No R3 seed has been used before registration.

contexts.rule: theta0 is run once on the 180 evidence-pool seeds. Context c (c = 0..14) shows the failing seeds with ascending rank 4c..4c+3 and the walking seeds with ascending rank 2c..2c+1 (6 seeds, ordered by seed number). STOP if the pool has fewer than 60 failing or 30 walking seeds.
contexts.freeze: contexts.json (15 contexts, both prompts per block, SHA-256 of every prompt) is committed BEFORE any model request
contexts.treatment_difference: arm M receives controller table + episode + measured evidence; arm N receives byte-identical controller table and episode block and the same system prompt; the only difference is the measured evidence

screening_set.rule: theta0 once on the 64 screen-pool seeds; screening seeds = first 8 walking + first 8 failing in ascending seed order; STOP if either class has fewer

arms.M: Nemotron with measured evidence (15 requests x 4 slots)
arms.N: Nemotron without measured evidence, identical controller/bounds/descriptions (15 x 4)
arms.RM: matched random counterpart of every M slot
arms.RN: matched random counterpart of every N slot
arms.H: rule-based heuristic (fixed edits, descriptive only): Derived from docs/PHASE2A_FAILURE_DIAGNOSIS.md (pre-R2): the failures are start-up failures to establish forward stepping with backward lean, so lean forward at start, lengthen the start-up ramp, raise the pitch reference. Fires only if at least half of the failing seeds of the evidence pool have <= 1 valid step. Written by the authors knowing the R2 outcome: a knowledgeable baseline, not a blind one.

proposal_contract.invalid_handling: no repair, no retries, no reordering; an invalid item or a missing item (fewer than 4 returned) is an empty slot = failure; a malformed envelope leaves all 4 slots empty

matched_random.streams: per (arm, block, slot): default_rng(SeedSequence([rng_base, 11 for M | 12 for N, block, slot])) permutation of the 15 parameters and 4 signs, drawn before any request
matched_random.valid_slot: k = number of model edits; magnitudes = the model's |delta_u| in the model's edit order; parameters/signs = first k of the stream
matched_random.invalid_or_empty_slot: fallback: 2 edits with magnitudes [0.1, 0.05]; same stream
matched_random.audit: requested and realised (after reflection at the bounds) delta_u are recorded per edit; matching is on requested magnitudes and the realised differences are reported
matched_random.freeze: candidates.json (all candidate vectors with provenance) is committed BEFORE any candidate is simulated; screening outcomes never alter prompts, comparators or selection

screening.seeds: the 16 screening seeds (common random numbers for every candidate and theta0)
screening.improved: >= 2 more walking seeds than theta0 on the same seeds

validation.ranking: screening gain, ties by earlier (block, slot)

primary_analysis.endpoint: per request block c: successes among the 4 slots (success = improved on screening seeds; invalid/empty model slot = failure); d_c = successes(M) - successes(RM)
primary_analysis.test: paired request-block exact sign-flip (randomisation) test over the 15 blocks, statistic sum d_c, null distribution enumerated exactly, two-sided
primary_analysis.claim_rule: claim 'model edits improve more often than matched random edits' only if p < 0.05 and mean d_c > 0
reporting: block bootstrap 95% interval of mean d_c (descriptive)
primary_analysis.completeness_rule: the confirmatory test is run only if all 30 requests were sent and none ended in a transport/HTTP error or budget refusal; otherwise the experiment is reported as incomplete

exploratory_analyses: M vs N, paired by block (sign-flip)

budget.ledger: experiments/phase2a_r3/results/ledger.jsonl (hash-chained, begin entries precede physics, session events feed the wall guard)
budget.feasibility: planned maximum 5268 rollouts <= cap 6000; verified by tests and by the pilot

stopping_rules: any hard limit reached (requests, tokens, rollouts, wall time, memory floor) stops the run; no extension, no retry
a transport/HTTP error or budget refusal on any request makes the experiment incomplete: remaining requests are not sent
screening-set or evidence-pool STOP outcomes are reported as the result
no model reply is edited, repaired, selected by hand or re-requested; scripted replies are never saved as results
provenance: prompt SHA-256 per request and arm
redacted call metadata per request (model id, usage, latency, request id)
token totals and estimated spend (assumed price bounds)
